style_alignment.rationale: Cyan crystal and warm plum-brown rock ramp sampled from face intact tile; chunky 8x8 cells enlarged to 16px on tunnel-interior floor band match face material family.

identity_continuity.rationale: First heap-ore chunk family; loose floor lumps read as ore chipped from the face seam for #434 wiring.

questions.question: Each chunk reads as a discrete lump of ore at 16px, not as a filled square or an indistinct blob.
questions.notes: Transparent margins on all four sides; angular shard silhouettes read as separate lumps at 2x on floor band.

questions.question: The three are distinguishable from one another by silhouette alone when laid out in a row.
questions.notes: chunk-a single peak, chunk-b twin peaks with top notch, chunk-c wider rock-heavy lump with chipped corner.

questions.question: The chunks read as the same material as the Face tiles - same cyan crystal and plum-brown rock family.
questions.notes: Shared cyan ramp (#18-58-71 through #114-226-210) and plum-brown rock values beside intact face tile in composite.

questions.question: Every Cell outside a chunk's silhouette is transparent, so the background shows through on all four sides.
questions.notes: Binary alpha runtime PNGs; floor band visible around every opaque pixel at native and 4x enlargement.

questions.question: Every tile is exactly 8x8, with no magenta inside a silhouette and no anti-aliased edge pixels.
questions.notes: All three PNGs 8x8 RGBA binary alpha; zero magenta and zero semi-transparent pixels.
